name.zh: OpenRLHF 强制 vLLM 不安全序列化

description: OpenRLHF 0.11.2 injects vLLM environment/config that re-enables pickle IPC. On a flat training network an adjacent actor reaches the worker's ZeroMQ/socket channel and deserialises attacker bytes.

params_schema.target: 目标 URL，例如 http://host:port（真实模式必需）
params_schema.mode: probe-only（默认，只读探测）| backup-write（写模块需 backup_targets）
params_schema.local_path: function-level 模块的本地文件/模型目录（仅读取，不反序列化）
